name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: n=$(git ls-files -z ':(glob)tests/**/*.py' | tr -cd '\0' | wc -c); [ "$n" -gt 0 ] || { echo 'no tracked tests/**/*.py guards found' >&2; exit 1; }; git ls-files -z ':(glob)tests/**/*.py' | xargs -0 -r -n1 python3 -I || { echo 'a tests/ guard failed' >&2; exit 1; }
